result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Fastest near you' section shows a duplicated restaurant card (Green Bowl Poké appears twice with identical image, delivery time, and fee), which looks like a data/rendering bug. The horizontal carousel also cuts off the third card ('Smash Bros Bu...') mid-word without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel lists 'Green Bowl Poké' twice with the exact same image, 15–25 min time, and €0.90 delivery fee, appearing as a duplicated/broken data entry.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list so each card represents a distinct restaurant; verify the data source isn't returning the same venue twice.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') is clipped at the right edge with the title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator, which can look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll hint (e.g., partial-card peek with gradient fade or pagination dots) and ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis at a word boundary.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) is horizontally cut off on the right with a partially visible chip, lacking a clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability of the filter chips.
